title: Phase 1-to-Present Process Review & State-Driven Validation
objective: Review Multiversal planning, implementation and agent behavior from Phase 1 through the current AAI boundary; preserve the product architecture that is working; remove current-state constants from executable validation; close application and AIOC CI trigger gaps; and establish a bounded recovery/evidence-lease operating rule that prevents repeated reconnaissance and owner-driven continuation loops.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: The prior triage correctly diagnosed CI and behavioral-control accretion but then repeatedly stopped at self-declared execution boundaries; the replacement flat validator also embedded current work-item IDs, SHAs and run IDs, while current CI omitted control-plane tests and root dependency changes.
diagnostic_hypotheses: Mutable repository state was encoded in executable validator constants instead of being derived from canonical registries and sealed proof data.
Recovery and authority checks had no freshness lease, so workers could restart reconnaissance without a concrete invalidating event.
Workflow path filters covered implementation directories but omitted root dependency/toolchain surfaces and AIOC control-plane regression tests.

changed_since_previous: MV-CONT-007 is completed_verified on live main.
The owner explicitly authorized the Phase 1-to-present review and related process/control improvements.
Repository, GitHub, Drive, Airtable and saved conversation evidence were inspected together and produced bounded implementation defects rather than another open-ended audit.

completion_gate: AAI-10 remains selected_not_started without implementation authority.
A durable Phase 1-to-present review identifies retained patterns, failure modes, chat-worker errors and the improved operating model.
The current AIOC validator derives active/completed work identity and proof values from canonical state rather than work-item-specific constants.
AIOC control-plane tests trigger and run in the one repository-health workflow.
Application root dependency, lockfile, toolchain, test and validation-tool changes trigger current-family health and substantive profile selection as appropriate.
The convergence policy establishes one recovery pass and an evidence-freshness lease with concrete invalidation triggers.
Focused regressions, exact-head repository health and live GitHub checks pass in both repositories before closeout.

ready_for_review_evidence.runner_recovery: Owner-controlled multiversal-linux-02 listener was safely restored; queued exact-head application health completed without candidate mutation.

completion_result: Multiversal's product architecture is affirmed while the delivery system is simplified: validator code now derives mutable identity/evidence from canonical state, current regression tests run in the one AIOC job, shared application dependency surfaces cannot bypass family validation, and one-pass recovery evidence remains valid until a concrete invalidation. The review records process history, worker failure modes, control budgets and the continuous execution golden path.
next_action: MV-CONT-008 is completed_verified with no further maintenance authority. AAI-10 remains selected_not_started; a future owner execution command must resolve its provider/source matrix, live-versus-fixture authority, persistence and bounded profile before governed start.
